outlook.statement: The management proposes to undertake a detailed review and valuation of the Company's assets and evaluate commercially viable opportunities for recommencement of operations during the financial year 2026–27. On the basis of the outcome of such review, the management will be able to take an informed decision on the business operations of the Company.

The industry is expected to witness continued growth in demand for biomass pellets and briquettes, particularly from thermal power plants and industrial users seeking to reduce dependence on fossil fuels. Government focus on increasing biomass co-firing, supply-chain infrastructure development, technology improvement, and support for pellet manufacturing is expected to create further opportunities.
